Every roll of the dice deserves a soundtrack. BG Soundbox gives your table the living, breathing audio layer it was always missing.

Get it on Google Play Join the Beta
01 Sound Library

A World of Sound at Your Fingertips

Hundreds of carefully curated audio effects — from dungeon ambiences to tavern chatter, battle cries to forest whispers. Organised by theme and tagged for instant search, so the right sound is always one tap away.

  • 500+ immersive board game sound effects
  • Organised by theme — fantasy, sci-fi, horror, and more
  • Instant search with smart tags
02 Mixer Console

Master Your Table's Atmosphere

A professional-grade mixing console built for the tabletop. Adjust individual track volumes in real time, loop ambient layers beneath triggered one-shots, and sculpt a soundscape as dynamic as the game itself.

  • Real-time multi-track mixing
  • Loop ambient sounds with one-shot triggers
  • Per-track volume, mute and solo controls
03 Soundboxes

Curated Sets for Every Adventure

Pre-built soundboxes tuned to specific games and genres. Drop one in and your table is transformed in seconds — or build your own from scratch and save it for every session.

  • Game-specific soundbox bundles
  • Fully customisable layouts
  • Save and reload your own creations
04 Community

Shared by Players, for Players

Browse a growing library of soundboxes crafted by the community. Discover fan-made packs for your favourite titles, publish your own creations, and vote for the sounds that bring your sessions to life.

  • Discover community-made soundboxes
  • Publish and share your own creations
  • Vote and curate your favourites
05 Bundles

Complete Packs, Instantly Ready

Import a full bundle — sounds, layouts, and metadata — from a single file. Perfect for game publishers, content creators, or anyone who wants a polished, turnkey audio experience right out of the box.

  • One-tap bundle import
  • Share packs with your group
  • Works offline, no internet required
